goal: Cursor loads bstack's agents and, once per update, the session-start notice of what changed.
changed: kitgen writes .cursor-plugin/plugin.json for a plugin that has rules, agents, commands, or hooks, and points its hooks field at hooks/cursor.json when that file exists.
bstack's hooks/cursor.json runs whats_new.py on sessionStart. Claude's hooks/hooks.json is unchanged, so the Stop hook and the commit gate stay on Claude Code.
whats_new.py --hook prints Cursor's additional_context when CURSOR_VERSION or CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT is set, and Claude's session-start JSON otherwise.

claims.claim: The Cursor manifest is generated, points at hooks/cursor.json, and the hook script prints additional_context for Cursor and the Claude payload otherwise.
claims.check: python3 tools/kitgen.py --check; python3 -m unittest tests.test_whats_new (15 tests); make versions BASE=origin/main
claims.remaining: No Cursor window has reloaded onto this plugin yet, so the session-start notice and the subagent list are not observed in the app.

next.item: Reload the Cursor window after this merges into the local agent-kit checkout, then start a chat.
next.why_now: The plugin files are already copied into ~/.cursor/plugins/local/bstack from the worktree. A sync from main before this manifest lands would drop that copy.
next.impact: beau-agent and comment-sicko show up as subagents, and the next agent-kit release shows once at session start.
